Today's lunch was a bit bad :-(
Apr 2024 • Friends
My table has 4 people. A common experience is the feeling that when ordered, the food has been pre-cooked and only reheated (but not heated enough so the food is not hot enough when brought out. Dishes like steak rice and lamb are dry, the first bite is eaten). completely disappointed.

The glass of white wine brought out an icy glass that looked very cool and eye-catching, but at the first sip I was surprised. The wine is cold! To give feedback, you should chill the wine for about 10 minutes and then bring out another glass (bring out the wine when you've almost finished eating the main dish). But the important thing is that if you don't know in advance, you will have to wait to chill the wine again because if you knew you had to wait, you would have asked for another drink.

Cod roe spaghetti: the noodles were not hot when brought out, on the table and then were not served with basic seasonings such as salt/pepper/olive oil or asked if the customer needed more cheese. When I asked for more salt, the server only brought me a jar of salt and did not offer the other spices.

When our team gives feedback to the store manager, they listen and receive information quite well. But we see that you (and also some other servers in our serve band) need to be equipped with the skills to handle feedback and confirm information from customers as it is. And more importantly, feedback is taken care of and resolved. I ate Miyama for the first time 2 years ago and the experience was never the same. Today I invited my friend to try it because I really like the brand and my friend said he wouldn't come back after today :(.

Tea and cake time
Sep 2020 • Couples
We had visited this place 1st time around one and a half or two years ago for lunch. 
(see my previous reviews and comments). 
This time we decided to try again and choose this place for the tea and cake.
We had Ceylon tea, Avocado Gelato, and Marchmille cake. Total bill: 374,000 VND.
The best of all was Avocado Gelato. 
Thus highly recommend trying.

We were a lucky one; we have three other staff who serve our table. 
The best was a gentleman who has well introduced Avocado Gelato and what surprise is waiting for us inside of the chocolate sphere. 

The owner of the restaurant highly recommends cleaning tablets and chairs.

Most Enjoyable Meal
Oct 2019 • Couples
We've always been fans of places like Muji Cafe and other Japanese cafes. Our first visit to Miyama Cafe was most enjoyable & one that exceeded our expectations. You would not imagine to have this quality of authentic Japanese food in vietnam but this cafe is as Jap as it can be with high quality ingredients & great taste/presentation.

The four cheese souffle with strawberry sorbet & raspberry sauce was exquisite, fluffy & light. Excellent texture with well balanced sweet, savory & tinge of sour taste from the sorbet. A perfect combination.
